limitations.text: Inventory not completed. (1) get_examples returned 0 training positives for this area, so few_shot/concept_vector retrieval has no seeds. (2) zero_shot_text is not configured. (3) imagery_window is refused for both gsi-seamless-aerial-japan and sentinel-2-l2a-cogs ('no imagery source'), so no candidate can be visually confirmed or rejected. (4) Only a synthetic 160 m AEF fixture index (idx-001, 3430 cells, 70x49, 16-d) was built; 160 m is the finest cell, chosen because warehouses are ~40-100+ m and 1280 m Clay cells are far too coarse. The full AOI (136.72-136.82E, 35.38-35.45N, ~9x8 km) was indexed but none of it was reviewed for warehouses. I made no counts or points because any would be fabricated. Count: unknown (range 0 to not estimable). Transfer: with no training city examples available, I can't say whether the workflow transfers. 10 m embeddings are likely to confuse warehouses with factories and other large roofs, so imagery verification would be needed.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses (>=~1600 m2 logistics/storage buildings) in AOI near Gifu/Aichi border (136.72-136.82E, 35.38-35.45N), 2024, as points with evidence, count range, and transfer note.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings may confuse factories with warehouses
Verification limited by budget and 20-cell vision limit
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x8 km. Embedding retrieval with few-shot examples from training split, then visual verification with GSI aerial imagery.
